review.shorterRoute: Original quotient and cusp germ identities determine the field diamond. Native Mobius order invariance identifies analytic places. The existing moving lemma covers every Picard class from finite analytic divisors, avoiding new cusp presentation. The existing primitive formula and degree zero remove the endpoint basepoint correction. Unique original constant-field place extension gives the arithmetic conorm square. Native Tate naturality composes the actual arithmetic Picard action with the original period tensor equivalence.
assumptionsToDischarge: The actual field diamond has the literal modular quotient, interior analytic germ and analytic place action.

The independent complex field/Picard diamond agrees with the original period quotient on every Picard class; the moving lemma discharges analytic representatives and degree zero discharges the basepoint term.
The original arithmetic-to-complex divisor conorm and Picard map intertwine the arithmetic and complex diamonds, by unique place extension and the proved field square.
For every Tate prime, the original arithmetic Picard diamond acts on the original p-adic period tensor by the native dual slash diamond, without extra prime restrictions or compatibility premises.
